name: budgy-ting
title: Household Cashflow Tracker
description: Track spending, detect recurring patterns, forecast cashflow with statistical models.
audience: Individuals and households who want to understand and forecast their spending without sharing data with a cloud service.
useCases: Import bank statements (CSV/JSON) and categorize transactions
Detect recurring spending patterns (rent, subscriptions, salary)
Forecast future cashflow using statistical models (Holt's exponential smoothing)
Track cash runway — how long your money will last
Compare spending across time periods with custom workspaces

dataPrivacy.storage: All data stored locally on-device using IndexedDB. No server, no cloud.
dataPrivacy.export: Full data exportable as JSON for backup or re-import.
dataPrivacy.thirdParty: No data sent to any external service.
